data.title: Skill
data.tagline: A specialized workflow and instruction package organized in a standard directory, with SKILL.md as the entry point for agents to execute on demand.
data.learningOutcome: You can inspect, install, use, create, and test a Skill folder.
data.description: A Skill can include instructions, scripts, references, and templates. When a task matches it, an agent reads those materials and follows the documented method.

learning.assumes: You have repeatedly given an AI agent the same steps, template, or review rules.
learning.outcome: You can inspect, install, use, create, and test a Skill folder.

distinctions.label: Plugin
distinctions.explanation: A Skill is a specialized workflow and knowledge bundle for AI agents; a Plugin is a software code package extending native commands and UI in the host application.

data.boundary: A Skill provides a method and related files; it does not automatically grant access to accounts, platforms, or external systems.

lessonPractice.title: Every week, a team teaches an Agent the same release-note rules and reuses scripts and templates. How can repetition be reduced?

options.label: Create a Skill with a SKILL.md entry plus triggers, steps, scripts, and templates
options.feedback: A clear entry to a stable workflow and resources lets the Agent reuse the same method for matching tasks.

options.label: Save only Write high-quality release notes and let the Agent infer the format each time
options.feedback: One goal provides no procedure, template, or acceptance criteria, so output still varies with context.

options.label: Put every project chat into the instruction file without separating triggers from durable rules
options.feedback: Irrelevant history dilutes the stable process and obscures when and how resources should be used.

data.agentPrompt: Package the weekly release-note workflow as a Skill: define triggers, inputs, steps, and acceptance in SKILL.md and keep scripts and templates in their directories. Exclude temporary chat and verify repeatability on a real change set.
